blueprint.title: Maths Half Paper — First Sitting

sections.instructions: This is a half-length paper — a real run, just shorter. Read each question slowly; most tell a little story. Work your answer out first, then find it and mark it. Rough working on paper is a good idea. No calculators.

blueprint.notes: DRAFT half-paper, doubly provisional like gl-maths-standard: strand-placeholder type ids until the Maths district ships, then reviewer verification of the representative spread. Authored, never a truncation (Addendum C §6).
